card.name: Quantity nouns right before "of"
card.fires_on: Nouns that measure an amount or group and are about to be followed by "of", such as worth, selection, generation, tons, swaths, bunches. Seen in general web prose.

modes.label: worth of
modes.description: The word "worth" after a time span or money amount, ahead of "of".

modes.label: Group or amount nouns
modes.description: Collective or plural amount nouns, sometimes cut partway through, that take "of" next.
modes.example: our website, we offer you a wide<< selection>> of coloring pages, pictures, photographs and

modes.label: Partway through plural amount words
modes.description: Ending pieces of words like tons, swaths, bunches, assortments, megawatts, right before "of".
modes.example: The twister killed six people and destroyed entire sw<<aths>> of the North Texas town.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "of" next, in several languages.
card.plain: It spots words like "worth", "selection" or "tons" that call for "of" right after them.
